changes: Six HH 1.41 Rites of War are now native selectable Rite entries with Legion/allegiance gating.
Legiones Hereticus is now a mutually-exclusive Late Heresy selector, gated to Traitor EC/TS/WB/SoH detachments.
All ten Inductii templates are selectable directly on Legion Tactical Squads with legion gating and priced template wargear options.
Thousand Sons Hereticus now hides normal Tactical Squads and exposes a compulsory-capable Inductii replacement squad.
Eight Corrupted Rites of War are now native Rite choices gated behind the matching Hereticus variant, with principal force-org prohibitions enforced.
All legion-specific HH1.41 units and characters are now hidden outside their correct Legion.
Eight Solar Auxilia Cohort Doctrines are native selectable entries; major role changes and Feral Fear purchase are machine represented, and doctrine access is attached to commanders.
Proscribed Techno-arcana is selectable on Magos/Archmagos Prime for Traitor detachments; new daemon engines are Traitor-gated.
Questoris Dark Blessings are selectable on Knight Armour and are mutually exclusive with Household Ranks at roster level.
